page.layout: One page of text in two parts: a narrow left margin of summary notes beside a central column of names, with years printed in the right margin beside each group of names. Page number at top centre.

l.note: Offensio nata inter domum Burg. & ordines Frisiæ Orient. propter Ioannem Falcoburg. tutelam filiorum fratris affectantem,
Maria regina Vng.gubernatrix Belgici Groningam venit. Contentio de portorio Emdano resuscitata.
Edictum Caroli v. contra Emdanos & reliquos Frisiæ orient. ordines.

page.notes: The left-margin notes are set beside the first name line of each group, and the right-margin years are set beside the group they belong to. Some printed initials and Latin spellings are uncertain at the scan's resolution, and a few name spellings (Iarges/Jarges, Horenken/Horneken) are reproduced as they appear. Light stains and show-through are not transcribed.
